decision.title: Lint for byte pointers without a length

body.p: (task 0.6), completing . The ast-grep rule pointer-parameter-without-length flags parameters in include/ and src/ that are a single pointer to char, signed char, unsigned char, uint8_t or int8_t. Object pointers, void * state or memory, and pointers to pointers are allowed. An external boundary that takes a NUL-terminated string (so far only sxml_byte_view_from_c_string) marks the line before with // ast-grep-ignore: pointer-parameter-without-length. tests/ is not covered: the test runner takes argv. SXML_TEST_REQUIRE now branches on the condition itself, so clang-analyzer knows what holds after it.
